items.raw_excerpt: Se trata de un pez del grupo de los Redfieldiiformes. Investigadores del Conicet señalaron que hasta el momento no se tenía registro de esa especie en el mundo.
items.summary_en: Scientists found fossil remains of a fish more than 240 million years old in Potrerillos, Argentina. It belongs to the Redfieldiiformes group, a species never recorded before in South America. The fossils fit in the palm of a hand and are very well preserved.
